contract.purpose: Give a first-time visitor an immediate, accurate read of what SaaS Maker is and which products are spotlighted, within one viewport.
contract.canonicalPurpose: SaaS Maker helps visitors evaluating Sarthak Agrawal's public products find the canonical product or source link by publishing a precise, durable, generated directory of maintained work.
contract.audience: Visitors evaluating the public products, existing users looking for canonical links, and search or AI agents discovering the portfolio.
contract.job: State what the product is and who it serves, show the spotlighted products, and offer the next action — a product page or the complete directory — within seconds.
contract.thesis: Ledger instead of grid: the spotlight becomes a ruled index where saturated pane color is earned on interaction, so two products read as two commissioned entries rather than a half-empty wall.
contract.system: One clear editorial pane carrying a wide headline beside a floating intro pane; the atelier photograph appears only as a masked glimpse at the right edge; product plaques are quiet clear panes separated by steel mullions that flood cobalt, oxblood, or amber on hover and focus.
contract.signature: Plaques flood with each product's saturated pane color on intent — the workshop's accent panes own the interaction state rather than sitting as static decoration.
contract.risk: Departing from the four-pane wall weakens the original wall-elevation metaphor; mitigated by keeping the steel frame, mullions, pane materials, Schibsted typography, and the one-arrival motion language.

findings: detect.mjs returned zero findings on Hero.astro and index.astro; note .astro files go through the regex engine only, so layout CSS was verified manually.

comprehension.reviewer: independent design-review subagent (Assessment A) reading the rendered surface

answers.product: SaaS Maker — the public directory of Fleet products plus the shared packages, skills, templates, and feedback layer behind them.
answers.audience: Visitors evaluating the builder's public products and existing users looking for canonical links; implied rather than stated outright.
answers.value: A precise, maintained map of real products with honest destinations — inspectable rather than marketing-inflated.
answers.mechanism: A generated directory: spotlighted products as ledger plaques, the complete register at /projects, real domains as proof.
answers.proof: Two real products with real domains and honest descriptions; the directory count and 'kept current' status line.
answers.nextAction: Open a product's details page from a plaque, or explore the complete directory.

ownerFeedback.note: Owner reviewed three live direction probes (monumental pair, plaque ledger, ghost panes) and selected B — plaque ledger.
